product.name: Atlas Release Readiness
product.summary: A local-first desktop product preparing a bounded release candidate review.
product.problem: Scattered release evidence can make provider completion look like product readiness.
product.desiredOutcome: Produce a traceable readiness observation without modifying source files or contacting a provider.
successSignals: The run is bound to an exact preview and governed context
Provider completion and outcome status remain separately recorded
The resulting evidence can be independently verified
product.firstWorkflow: Review a fixed release evidence packet through the offline managed runtime.

initiative.title: Review the Atlas release evidence packet
initiative.outcome: A bounded observation records what the supplied evidence can and cannot establish.

referenceEvidence.statement: Candidate 0.1.0 has local build and contract-test evidence. Native installation, live-provider behavior, security completion, human acceptance, release authorization, and deployment approval are not recorded.

limitations: This is a deterministic realistic reference scenario, not a real Product baseline or production readiness decision.
Provider execution uses local fixtures; live authentication, entitlement, reachability, quality, usage, and cost remain untested.
Native host interaction, accessibility, independent human review, and Product Owner acceptance remain unestablished.
The Product Owner explicitly skipped the interrupted Codex Security scan; this scenario is not security assurance.
